search_description: Searches documents, tasks, items, events, files (including the text of supported formats) and records. Only what you can see is shown.
search_date_hint: Dates match a task's due date (or its start date if none), an event's start date, and otherwise the date it was last edited.
search_reversed: The start date is after the end date.
search_failed: Search failed. Try again in a moment.
search_author_hint: The author is the person who created the document, task and so on. Choosing one shows only what they created that you can see. The member list is for the workspace you are in.
